notes:
=== CONCEPT ===
SOA (Start of Authority) record reveals the primary nameserver, the zone administrator's email address (encoded: first dot is @), serial number, and refresh/retry/expire timers.

=== CHAINING ===
dig soa → extract admin email for OSINT/phishing context → extract primary NS for AXFR attempt → serial number timestamps indicate last zone change.

=== ADMIN EMAIL ===
The RNAME field contains the zone admin email with the @ replaced by a dot. Converting back gives a real contact useful for social engineering context and correlating with other findings (SNMP contact, cert email).
